text:
sara-cs: FYI — onboarding for AcmePay hitting lots of 429s right after SDK init. Customer sees repeated preflight + ephemeral token refresh failing.

lee-sdk: Can you paste the SDK config and auth flow? Are they using ephemeral tokens from our example or a custom token server?

sara-cs: Using browser SDK with ephemeral tokens issued by their backend. They say tokens are generated with issued_at (iat) and exp set correctly. Attach logs:
```
[2024-11-12T14:02:12Z] auth: token rejected: nbf in future (nbf: 1718204538)
[2024-11-12T14:02:12Z] request: 429 preflight
```

dmitri-eng: 'nbf in future' screams clock skew. Ask them to check client device/system clock vs token server. Also retry settings look aggressive — default retry=5 with 0ms jitter will stampede.

sara-cs: Pushed them a quick repro snippet of the token fields. They're in JS: `iat: Date.now()/1000` — could be float vs int? Also timezone oddness.

lee-sdk: Float is fine but some libs parse ints only. Recommend truncating: `Math.floor(Date.now()/1000)` and include a 5s leeway. Also set client retry to exponential backoff + jitter, e.g., base 100ms, factor 2, max 2s, jitter 0.3.

inna-ops: Also advise running `date -u` / `ntpstat` on their token issuer host and browser environment? For mobile apps, check device auto-time settings.

sara-cs: Customer did `date -u` — their token server is 6 seconds ahead of client's laptop. They reproduced by manually skewing clock and saw same 429s.

dmitri-eng: Two mitigation paths:
1) Quick patch: add 10s 'nbf' tolerance on token validation (server side) or increase SDK grace window by setting `tokenGrace: 10` in client config.
2) Long term: fix NTP on issuer host and ensure tokens include small `iat` leeway and use ints.

sara-cs: Sent both recommendations. Customer applied client-side `tokenGrace: 12` and reduced retry concurrency; 429 rate dropped to normal. They want guidance for prod rollout.

lee-sdk: Created a short FAQ blurb for onboarding: clock skew, use Math.floor for iat, enable tokenGrace, use jittered backoff. I'll drop it in the onboarding doc and ping @docs-team.

deploy-bot: rolled out canary 'token-grace' flag to hosted staging (service: auth-validator, version: v2.3.1-canary) :rocket:

sara-cs: Thanks all — will follow up in 24h to confirm sustained health. :thumbsup:
